title: Specifications for Audio Level and Multifrequency Test Film for 70-mm Striped Six-Track Release Print Audio Reproducers, Magnetic Type
scope: This practice specifies an audio frequency test film to be used for adjusting the sensitivity and frequency response of 70-mm striped six-track motion-picture magnetic audio reproducers intended for release prints operating at 120 perforations per second or approximately 112 ft (34 m) per minute.
